title: [DECISION] Test vectors use OpenSSL oracle (not derived from code)
description: tests/userspace/test_kdf.c lines 37-84: Two-stage HKDF ikm_fd chain vectors (ikm_fd_stage1_ikm, ikm_fd_stage2_salt, ikm_fd_stage2_okm) are verified against OpenSSL 3.0.13, not derived from the module's own code. The test comment at lines 37-46 shows the exact OpenSSL commands used: 'Stage 1: IKM = ...' with explicit 'openssl kdf' invocation and hex salt/info arguments. This is the standard independent-oracle pattern: the test encrypts/derives with the module and compares against a third-party reference implementation. The vectors are hardcoded as static arrays (lines 47-84), making tests fully offline. This pattern prevents test artifacts (e.g., a test that derives with OpenSSL, encrypts with the module, then decrypts with the same module) which would pass trivially. The OpenSSL oracle is non-negotiable per CLAUDE.md 'Test Design Constraint' section.
